title: Portal Chats: mark a conversation "Waiting for client"
text: When you are waiting for a client to answer, you can now mark the conversation. It appears under a new Waiting tab, longest wait first, with the number of days. The mark ends by itself when the client writes back. If they stay silent for 3 days, the client gets an automatic reminder by email and in their portal.
points: Hourglass button beside the emoji button: tick it before Send
New Waiting tab, longest-waiting first, with days waited
Automatic reminder to the client after 3 days of silence (at most 2)

steps.name: Tick the hourglass, then send
steps.detail: It sits beside the emoji button in the message box.

steps.name: Open the Waiting tab
steps.detail: See who has not answered yet, longest wait first.

steps.name: Clear it by hand if needed
steps.detail: Click the hourglass on the conversation row.
